release_name: Live TV v5.1.7 — Fixed Sticky Search & Edge-to-Edge Phone TV Player
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🔍 Fixed Channels Search Bar in Mobile Remote: Relocated and pinned sticky at the very top of the Channels view with solid backdrop and shadow, ensuring it is immediately accessible and never hides under the top bar

📌 Fixed Sticky Search Bar in Mac App: Transformed search container into a fixed glassmorphic sticky header pinned to the top of the browser view, allowing instant live search from anywhere while browsing channels

📱 Edge-to-Edge Phone TV Video Player: Expanded mobile video player to 100% full phone width with zero side margins, increased aspect height, and cover fill, completely eliminating letterboxing black side bars
⚡ Perfectly Padded Mobile Controls: Wrapped all player buttons, dials, and quick surfer in a comfortable cushioned container below the edge-to-edge video
🛡️ 100% Ad-Free Live TV (Zero-Ad Shield): Zero commercial interruptions across all 2,989 channels
